visualCharacteristics.purpose: doctor location finder (address input, radius select, submit, use current location) that hands off to the find-a-doctor page; not a site content search
visualCharacteristics.layout: stacked form fields; usually placed in a split section beside an image and heading

contentPattern.structure: one setting per row in this order, or key | value rows: (1) label text 'Search by address or postal code'; (2) input placeholder 'Your location'; (3) radius list in miles, e.g. '5, 10, 25, 50' (a bold value is the default, otherwise 10); (4) submit link 'Find a doctor' to /en-us/find-a-doctor (link text is the button label); (5) 'Use my current location' text (omit the row to hide the geolocation button). Sends address, radius, lat and lng query parameters

suitableFor: doctor, provider or store locator entry points that redirect to a results page
postal-code plus radius search calls to action
notSuitableFor: site content search over a query index (use search)
full results pages with maps and listings
